label: XA_TERMS_OF_TRADE_RELATIVE_VALUE
hypothesis: Currency and commodity futures are two claims on the same terms-of-trade factor. The residual after removing commodity beta explains relative mispricing. Mean reversion over 21 sessions.

basket_construction.rationale: Each commodity represents one facet of the export basket. No fitting to outcome; purely economic reasoning. Equal weight is transparent and defensible.

beta_estimator.formula: beta_t = cov(fx_ret, basket_ret) / var(basket_ret), estimated over window [t-window, t-1]
beta_estimator.window_description: 63 trading days (~3 months at 252 trading days/year)
beta_estimator.lag: 1 session (beta at time t is estimated on data strictly before t)
beta_estimator.lag_rationale: No look-ahead: at decision time t, beta is estimated using information through t-1

residual_interpretation: The part of the FX move NOT explained by commodity basket moves; captures relative mispricing of the two claims

features.source: 6A futures return minus beta-adjusted GC,HG,SI basket return
features.availability_instant: After session close (all futures data available after close)
features.formula: residual_6A_t = ret_6A_t - beta_6A_t * (equal_weighted_sum(ret_i_t for i in ['GC', 'HG', 'SI']))

features.source: 6C futures return minus beta-adjusted CL,NG,RB basket return
features.availability_instant: After session close (all futures data available after close)
features.formula: residual_6C_t = ret_6C_t - beta_6C_t * (equal_weighted_sum(ret_i_t for i in ['CL', 'NG', 'RB']))

features.source: 6N futures return minus beta-adjusted ZL,ZS,LE,HE basket return
features.availability_instant: After session close (all futures data available after close)
features.formula: residual_6N_t = ret_6N_t - beta_6N_t * (equal_weighted_sum(ret_i_t for i in ['ZL', 'ZS', 'LE', 'HE']))

6A.name: AUD/USD
6A.declared_gaps: Australian coal export exposure not represented (R38 has no coal futures). Coal represents ~3-4% of global thermal coal supply but is not included in the GC, HG, SI basket.

6C.name: CAD/USD
6C.declared_gaps: None material. CL, NG, RB capture the dominant Canadian export mix: crude, natural gas, and refined products.

6N.name: NZD/USD
6N.declared_gaps: New Zealand dairy exports (butter, milk powder, cheese) represent ~20-25% of NZ export value and are NOT represented. No dairy futures contract exists in R38. Dairy is typically more price-stable than grains/meat and has different term-structure behavior.

leakage_check_details.fx_data_lag: 0 sessions (return calculated from previous close to current close, available after session close)
leakage_check_details.basket_data_lag: 0 sessions (all components are futures returns, available after session close)
leakage_check_details.beta_lag: 1 session (estimated on data strictly before decision instant t, no forward data used)
leakage_check_details.decision_instant_lag: After session close at time t, feature uses data through t-1 for beta, data at t for returns
leakage_check_details.no_look_ahead: Confirmed: all inputs available before or at decision instant

frozen_parameters.expected_sign: Positive: mean reversion hypothesis predicts residuals revert, so negative residuals (underpriced FX) should reverse upward.
frozen_parameters.beta_window: 63 trading days (~3 months). Window length frozen to avoid optimization after observing data.
frozen_parameters.basket_composition: Declared per currency pair and frozen before measurement. No adjustment after observing returns.
frozen_parameters.basket_weights: Equal-weight per pair. Frozen before measurement; no optimization to outcome.
frozen_parameters.horizon: 21 sessions (1 trading month). Declared in cell specification.
frozen_parameters.cost_model: To be declared by trend-breadth-signal-agent. Feature layer provides residual signal; cost model is separate.
frozen_parameters.passive_control: To be declared by trend-breadth-signal-agent. Feature provides raw residual; signal agent defines the control baseline.
